## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (55%)** · Unreliable input · Careful review
Low reliability (48%) on a JPEG-degraded simulated frozen section [F6] with 45% Benign probability warrants deferring margins [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Normal 55%, Benign 45%, InSitu 0%, Invasive 0% (risk 0%) [F1] | Split Normal vs Benign; 0% invasive |
| Conformal set | {Normal} at 90% coverage (test 90%, ECE 5%, n=132) | Single class at dataset guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | Reliability 48% (flagged), OOD 74%, 12/12 tiles, AUROC 70% | Suspect input; degraded frozen section |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | False (top-class disagreement) | Independent foundation models disagree |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Normal (87%–90% similarity); Benign contrast 84% [F5] | Unanimous Normal among nearest neighbors |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 2, 6, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (1.48, contribution -1.37) [F2]; 0/20 AI spot check · Unreliable
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 3, 6, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (1.51, contribution -0.62) lowers invasive score [F3] · Weak
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 0, 11) · context · Above-typical descriptive score (1.10, contribution -0.53) [F4]; 8/20 spot check · Weak
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 11) · ↓ invasive · Low score (0.09, contribution -0.47) pulls away from invasive · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; removing top 3 risk regions drops invasive probability vs random (+0.011, 95% CI +0.002 to +0.020).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (+0.0008, 95% CI -0.009 to +0.006 includes 0); case leans on unreliable **normal lobules** (0/20 check).

## Could be wrong if
- Severity-3 JPEG degradation and simulated frozen-section artifacts (48% reliability, 74% OOD) mask a benign or atypical lesion.
- True category is Benign (45% probability, 84%-similar contrast case BACH_0384), given CONCH–MUSK disagreement and unreliable lobule scoring.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 10**: Inspect highest-risk tiles (21%, 16%) and medial margin (61% in region 0); defer margin call.
2. **Regions 2, 3, 6, 11**: Verify tubules and two-layered lobular epithelium directly, as normal-lobules scoring is unreliable.
3. **Regions 0–11**: Assess frozen-section quality across all 12 regions; consider drafted recut H&E and deeper levels.
